reviewed_by: Claude (harness crash recovery); selection reviewed against the diff by the implementing agent, root cause independently validated by a separate subagent
reason: A project worker that lost its lease during goal-driven harness work left the replacement's recovery held forever: reconcile_dead_project settled only provider turns, so harness goal claims (execution_owner_id harness-runtime) and the dead owner's running/uncertain durable commands became recovery blockers that only HarnessRuntimeService.startup or an unwired resolve_uncertain could clear, and startup runs only after recovery verifies. runtime_orphan_recovery.py now releases those harness claims (any turn status) and fails the dead owner's running requests plus earlier uncertain ones without retry (storage reports keep their begin_recovery requeue), recording both in the orphans_reconciled receipt. The operator accepts that a resumed goal may repeat a step. test_runtime_orphan_recovery.py adds the harness/command case and the no-death-proof case; the other files cover recovery holds, controls, reconciliation.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright change: the UI already renders interrupted turns and paused goals. Real-Core check ran on a loopback scratch Core from this branch with an inert fake Codex app-server (goal turn claimed, ownership row lock forced LeaseLost; recovery verified in 2 s with released_claim_ids, goal paused, resume worked, transcript read 200); the non-loopback LAN bind was refused by this agent's permission policy, so the LAN-origin gate is not met. Locally, test_runtime_reconciliation (worker spawn), the PostgreSQL variants of two test_recovery_controls tests fail identically on unmodified origin/main in this environment; both were green in recently merged CI selections. PostgreSQL variants skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL. tests/v3/test_product_knowledge.py is not selected: test_product_search_finds_headless_core_and_paired_butler_cli is already red on main (fails locally at f9d7c96~1, f9d7c96 and origin/main, and failed in this PR's first CI run) and is unrelated to the two reworded recovery paragraphs; build_product_knowledge.py --verify passes on the regenerated index (453 passages).
